svg.text: motor speed for the same camera turn, by roll angle
3-axis gimbal · yaw → roll → pitch · gimbal lock
turn the middle axis to 90° and the outer and inner axes line up
keep roll small, and let the drone's own yaw take the big turns

text.tspan: # each motor's axis, in the world
# 90°: the pitch axis is the yaw axis, one turn lost
# near the lock, the motors can't keep up
